source_type: Manually transcribed published historical statistics, not synthetic
precision_note: Uses published one-decimal PPR values. Montgomery week 5 is rounded 18.2; the extra 0.02 from passing yardage is below source display precision. No calculation claims hundredth-point source precision.
fields: standard_points = published PPR minus receptions; half/PPR add 0.5/1.0 per reception. No custom bonuses.
important_reconciliation: Stevenson week 2 = 21.2 PPR including a successful two-point conversion.
Stevenson week 16 = 17.8 PPR including a successful two-point conversion.
Missing weeks remain absent, never fabricated as zeros.
StatMuse values and NFL game-log week labels were inspected; this is not an automated source-reconciliation run.
point_in_time: Retrieved retrospectively. Weekly cutoffs prevent future-game feature leakage, but original historical publication vintages and later stat corrections are not reconstructed.
